rare_outcomes: Raman (HJH vol. 1, pp. 249-250): Jupiter or Venus in the lagna with the 6th lord, aspected by Saturn, Rahu or Mars, brings trouble from relatives

PVR Narasimha Rao (ch. on mundane charts, chart 81): Rahu's aspect on the lagna of a nation's new-year chart can disturb general well-being in Rahu dasha

lagna_or_context_notes: Calculator convention: Rahu aspects the 5th, 7th and 9th from itself, so it aspects house 1 from houses 9, 7 and 5. Sources differ: Vijnananda's note to Brihat Jataka 2.13 gives full aspects on the 5th, 7th, 9th and 12th counted backward (so from houses 5, 7, 9 - the same set - and also from house 12), three-quarter from houses 2 and 10, half from houses 3, 4, 6, 8; BPHS 26 says only that all planets aspect the 7th; PVR (by omission) and Braha give Rahu no graha drishti. Raman notes Rahu generally behaves like Saturn (HJH vol. 1, p. 43). Calculator dignity default: exalted in Taurus, debilitated in Scorpio.

effects: toxins in the body through swelling, or the evil eye

disagreements: Which aspects Rahu has is disputed. Calculator: 5th, 7th, 9th. Vijnananda (note to Brihat Jataka 2.13): full 5th, 7th, 9th, 12th counted in reverse, plus partial aspects on the 2nd, 10th, 3rd, 4th, 6th, 8th, none on the 1st and 11th; counted backward the 5th and 9th fall on the same houses as forward, but the reverse 12th lands on the house just ahead of Rahu. BPHS 26.2-5: only 'all planets aspect the 7th', nodes not named. PVR Narasimha Rao: no graha drishti for the nodes (only rasi drishti). Braha: the nodes cast no aspects; few astrologers accept the texts that give them. Raman uses nodal aspects in his rules without specifying houses. Sanjay Rath's position on nodal graha drishti could not be verified (the Crux text read applies Rahu's rasi drishti).
phrasing_guidance: Mention only a tendency to restlessness or outside disturbance, and only if other factors agree; no health claims.
